titulo: The future perfect to guess about the past
subtitulo: Habrá ido a la estética. Se habrán dormido.
regla: The future perfect (habré, habrás, habrá... + participle) can express a guess about something that has happened: Habrá salido = He must have gone out / He's probably gone out. Often a reply to something in the present or present perfect.

bloques.texto: The **future perfect** can express a **supposition about the recent past**. English says _must have_ or _probably_.
No extra word is needed; the tense itself carries the guess.
It's often triggered by a comment in the **present** or **present perfect**.
Compare: about the present, use the simple future (**estará en casa**); further back, the conditional (**llegaría a las tres**).
Tip: **habrá** + participle = I bet it's already happened.

lista.es: ==Se habrán dormido== al llegar al hotel; el viaje fue larguísimo.
lista.en: They must have gone to sleep when they got to the hotel; the trip was super long.

lista.es: Lo ==habré conocido== antes; su cara se me hace conocida.
lista.en: I must have met him before; his face looks familiar.

lista.es: —Marisa está muy guapa hoy. —==Habrá ido== a la estética.
lista.en: —Marisa looks great today. —She must have gone to the salon.

lista.es: —¿A dónde fue tu hermano? —==Habrá ido== a casa de Miguel. Siempre va los sábados.
lista.en: —Where did your brother go? —He's probably gone to Miguel's. He always goes on Saturdays.

filas.t: Habrá sido muy caro ahorita. (about now)
